title.zh: 一步加到第 t 步

brief.zh: 扩散模型给图加噪：x_t = √ᾱ · x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ) · ε。按公式输出 x_t。
brief.en: A diffusion model adds noise to a picture: x_t = √ᾱ · x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ) · ε. Output x_t by the formula.

hint.zh: √ᾱ 和 √(1 − ᾱ) 都是一个数，乘到整张图上。
hint.en: √ᾱ and √(1 − ᾱ) are each a single number, multiplied onto the whole picture.

after.zh: ᾱ 从 1 慢慢减到 0，图一点点没进噪声里。两个系数的平方加起来是 1，所以不管加到哪一步，图的总「能量」大致不变。这个公式让训练时能直接跳到任意一步，不用一步步加。
after.en: As ᾱ falls slowly from 1 to 0, the picture sinks little by little into the noise. The squares of the two coefficients add up to 1, so whatever the step, the total "energy" of the picture stays about the same. This formula lets training jump straight to any step without adding noise step by step.

t.zh: 现在最好的图像生成模型叫扩散模型。它的训练从反方向开始：先把一张图一点点加噪，直到只剩噪声。
t.en: The best image generators today are called diffusion models. Their training starts the other way round: noise is added to a picture little by little until only noise is left.

t.zh: 加到哪一步，用一个数 ᾱ 表示图还剩多少：1 是原图，0 是纯噪声。
t.en: How far it has gone is given by one number, ᾱ, how much of the picture is left: 1 is the original, 0 is pure noise.

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：按说明里的公式，一步算出加到第 t 步的图。
t.en: Your task in this level: by the formula in the brief, work out in one step the picture after noise is added up to step t.

desc.zh: 输出 √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε：把 x₀ 一步加噪到第 t 步。
desc.en: Outputs √ᾱ·x₀ + √(1 − ᾱ)·ε: x₀ noised straight to step t.
